long_biography.plain_text:
Crossroads Centre Antigua turned Eric Clapton’s experience of recovery into a lasting treatment institution. He founded the residential centre in 1998 to make addiction care available in the Caribbean and beyond, with scholarships intended to widen access for people unable to meet the cost.

Clapton has used music itself to support that purpose. The Crossroads Guitar Festival brings artists together in benefit concerts, while selected guitar auctions have also raised money for the centre’s foundation. Festival proceeds support the centre’s scholarship fund, alongside residential treatment, family support and aftercare programmes.
